objective: Enforce the documented three-person clean-machine cold-start protocol, rejecting incomplete, placeholder, out-of-order and unbounded participant records.
acceptance: exactly three participant records are required, not a minimum of three
every documented field is mandatory and template placeholder values are rejected
timestamps parse as timezone-aware UTC and satisfy started_at <= first_health_at <= first_ready_at
pass records require a log reference and elapsed_minutes at or below 60
fail records require a blocking log reference
invalid results and non-finite or negative elapsed values fail closed
the checked-in template is proven not to be acceptable evidence
the evidence file is read through the shared strict JSON loader
evidence: focused cold-start validation test output covering incomplete, out-of-order, duplicate, placeholder, pass and fail records
CLI output showing a valid panel is accepted and the template is rejected
full repository test output and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: real participant or hardware evidence is required
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a new dependency outside the standard library is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
